64 cases. The same list is in the app: type `/tests`.

| MF-API-01 | 1.2 API (REST / GraphQL) | The whole flow, approve everything | `Test the REST API at https://api.example.com/v1 for authorization issues` | Every step at ✓; the cookie value never shows in the log, the findings or the report. |

| MF-API-05 | 1.2 API (REST / GraphQL) | Reject at MEDIUM | `Test the REST API at https://api.example.com/v1 for authorization issues` | The rejected MEDIUM request never runs; the plan goes on and HIGH runs only after its own approval. |

| MF-NET-03 | 1.3 Network (IP address or range) | Wrong addresses are refused | `scan 10.0.0.300` | Each bad address shows its message and nothing starts; the CIDR range starts. |
| MF-NET-04 | 1.3 Network (IP address or range) | Scope edit and ports suggested in chat | `Scan 10.0.0.0/24 for open ports` | Only your tick changed the scope; the wrong values changed nothing. |
| MF-NET-05 | 1.3 Network (IP address or range) | The HIGH double check and blocked parameters | `Check 10.0.0.0/24 for exposed management consoles` | Only an in-scope host:port can be set; HIGH runs only after the second Yes; a check moved to another host never confirms the finding. |
| MF-SRC-01 | 1.4 Source Code (git repo or folder) | The whole flow, approve everything | `Review the repo https://github.com/acme/app for secrets and insecure code` | Every step at ✓; the hardcoded password never shows in plain text. |
| MF-SRC-02 | 1.4 Source Code (git repo or folder) | Other ways to name a repository | `review git@github.com:acme/app.git` | All repository forms are understood; the incomplete one is explained. |
| MF-SRC-03 | 1.4 Source Code (git repo or folder) | Paths that leave the repository are blocked | `Check https://github.com/acme/app for hardcoded secrets` | Only files inside the repository and outside the excluded paths can be read. |
| MF-SRC-04 | 1.4 Source Code (git repo or folder) | Reorder the gated checks in the plan | `Review https://github.com/acme/app for security issues` | The run follows the order you saved; the phases never move. |
| MF-SRC-05 | 1.4 Source Code (git repo or folder) | Stop during the run | `Review the repo https://github.com/acme/app for secrets and insecure code` | Keep running loses nothing; Stop now runs nothing else and keeps what was found. |

| RULE-05 | 2b Chat: step rules (Reconix decides) | The scope is locked after approval | `add port 3389` | "The scope is approved and locked…": start a new assessment (/new) to test something else. |
